eco.headline: Everything the lyceum needs in one account

dashboard.title: Your day at a glance
dashboard.text: The home page gathers what matters today.
dashboard.p1: Today's lessons with rooms and teachers
dashboard.p2: GPA, absences and homework in one place
dashboard.p3: Latest marks, notebooks and library at hand
dashboard.alt: The home page on a tablet

timetable.title: Timetable and marks without asking around
timetable.text: The school week from Monday to Friday and every mark, as soon as it is set.
timetable.p1: Changes and moved lessons show up at once
timetable.p2: Marks by subject with the average
timetable.p3: A notification for every new mark

assistant.title: An AI assistant and notebooks that learn with you
assistant.text: Add lessons, files and notes as sources and ask questions: answers cite where they come from.
assistant.p1: Notebooks built from your own sources
assistant.p2: Studio makes quizzes, flash cards, mind maps and reports
assistant.p3: Web search is a switch you control
assistant.alt: An AI notebook on a laptop

journal.title: A journal that saves teachers' time
journal.text: Marks and attendance for a whole class on one screen.
journal.p3: Export the journal in one click
journal.alt: The teachers' journal on a laptop

library.title: Library and courses in the same place
library.text: Find a book, see if it is free, and continue your course where you stopped.

bot.title: Telegram bot and mini app
bot.text: Marks and the timetable arrive in the chat; the full app opens inside Telegram.
bot.p1: New marks and tomorrow's lessons in the chat
bot.p2: Ask the assistant right in Telegram
bot.p3: The mini app signs you in by itself
bot.alt: The Telegram bot on a phone
bot.alt2: The mini app on a phone

excuses.title: Excuses with a clear status
excuses.text: Send a note and documents, follow the decision and chat with the curator.
excuses.p1: Pending, approved or rejected at a glance

cta.title: Ready to start?
cta.text: Sign in with your lyceum account and everything is already there.

demo.question: Why do leaves turn yellow in autumn?
demo.answer: Chlorophyll breaks down, and the yellow and orange pigments that were hidden underneath become visible.
demo.journalHint: Excused lessons are locked for marks.

thread.student: I was ill, the note is attached.
thread.curator: Thank you, I am reviewing it.

demo.courseHint: Finish all modules to get it.

banner.intro: Prospective student or a parent of one? Ask your questions in our unofficial

mcp.title: Connect your own AI assistant
mcp.text: The platform runs MCP servers, so students and teachers can link ChatGPT, Claude or any other MCP-capable assistant to their account. You choose what it may access in the ID app, scope by scope.
mcp.p1: Ask about the timetable, homework and marks
mcp.p2: Upload files and hand in homework
mcp.consent: Access is granted per scope and can be revoked at any time.
